title: 第6591章 我不知道你的自信来自哪里第6590章 叫天天不应叫地地不灵
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: 推荐各位书友阅读：吞噬古帝第6591章我不知道你的自信来自哪里（..la）整整两天时间。
苏辰借助混沌吞噬诀和吞噬血轮，才勉强地吞噬了整个虚空雷城的所有力量，使得自身伤势彻底痊愈。
要不是融合虚空雷城的所有生灵力量，相信短时间内，他的伤势根本无法恢复。
先知族还真是够狠的。
竟然直接炼化了整个虚空雷城。
苏辰也是给先知族竖起大拇指，不过他肯定不会轻易善罢甘休。
现在的他肯定不是先知族的敌手，不能选择硬碰硬。
先将消息传出去。
随着苏辰的故意泄露出去，整个小世界的东域，几乎全部都在疯传虚空雷城被炼化的事情。
在小世界的东域，虚空雷城绝对属于最顶级的城市之一。
“我刚刚听说，虚空雷城被先知族炼化了。”
“我也听说了，真是够狠的，虚空雷城无数武者，单单是大帝强者就不知道有多少，先知族竟然全部炼化，一个不留。”
“你们是否知道，先知族为了什么。”
“不知道，这些顶级势力做事，哪还有原因，想做什么就做什么。”
“真是太可怕了。”
“我还听说，先知族下一个炼化的目标就是荒古书院。”
“连虚空雷城都扛不住，更何况荒古书院。”
同样得到消息的荒古书院，如今却是人心惶惶，有着虚空雷城的前车之鉴，很多学员都已经开始纷纷离开。
不敢继续留下，毕竟他们只是想要在书院修炼，而不是想要丢掉性命。
要是换做其他势力，哪怕是稍稍比荒古书院强，他们都愿意搏一搏。
唯独现在。
他们要是选择继续留下，必定会被先知族活生生的炼化，只要想想都感到绝望。
“院长，我们和先知族之间无恩无怨，我实在想不通，先知族为什么要炼化我们。”
“虚空雷城和先知族也没有恩怨，但却是被先知族直接炼化，我已经亲自前往虚空雷城，所有人全部被炼化，一个都没有跑掉，宛如人间炼狱一般。”
“我们不能赌，要是赌输的话，整个荒古书院都会被炼化。”
“没错，先知族太过强大，我们无法抗衡。”
先知族，拥有永生境和先知王坐镇的顶级势力。
奎峰想来想去，都想不出自己到底哪里招惹了先知族。
能赌吗？
不愿意赌。
也不敢赌。
正如副院长所说，要是赌输的话，到时候整个荒古书院都会被炼化，死无葬身之地，这是他无法接受的结果。
“通知下去，要是有愿意离开的人，可以随时离开书院。”
“院长，那你呢？”
“我要留下。”
不是不想走。
能走？

With the help of the Chaos Devouring Technique and the Devouring Blood Wheel, Su Chen reluctantly devoured all the power of the entire Void Thunder City, completely recovering from his injuries.
If it weren't for the integration of all the living creatures in Void Thunder City, I believe that his injuries would not be able to recover in a short period of time.
The Prophet clan is really ruthless.
It actually directly refined the entire Void Thunder City.
Su Chen also gave the Prophet Clan a thumbs up, but he would definitely not give up easily.
Now he is definitely not an opponent of the Prophet clan and cannot choose to fight head-on.
Get the word out first.
Following Su Chen's deliberate leak, almost everyone in the Eastern Region of the small world was spreading wild rumors about the refining of Void Thunder City.
In the Eastern Region of the small world, Void Thunder City is definitely one of the top cities.
"I just heard that Void Thunder City was refined by the Prophet Clan."
"I've heard about it too. It's really cruel. There are countless warriors in Void Thunder City, and there are countless powerful emperors alone. The Prophets actually refined all of them, leaving no one behind."
"Do you know what the Prophets are doing?"
"I don't know, these top forces have no reason for doing things. They just do whatever they want."
"It's just terrible."
"I also heard that the Prophet clan's next refining target is the Ancient Academy."
"Even Void Thunder City can't hold it, let alone the Ancient Academy."
The Ancient Academy, which also received the news, is now in panic. Taking a lesson from Void Thunder City, many students have begun to leave.
They didn't dare to stay. After all, they just wanted to practice in the academy, not to lose their lives.
If it were another force, even if it was slightly stronger than the Ancient Academy, they would be willing to give it a try.
Only now.
If they choose to stay, they will definitely be refined by the Prophet clan, which makes them feel desperate just thinking about it.
"Dean, there is no grudge between us and the Prophet Clan. I really can't figure out why the Prophet Clan wants to refine us."
"There is no grudge between Void Thunder City and the Prophet Clan, but they were directly refined by the Prophet Clan. I have personally gone to Void Thunder City, and everyone has been refined. No one has escaped. It's like purgatory on earth."
"We can't bet. If we lose, the entire Ancient Academy will be refined."
"Yes, the Prophet clan is too powerful and we cannot compete."
The Prophet clan is the top power with the realm of immortality and the seat of the Prophet King.
Kui Feng thought about it, but he couldn't figure out where he had offended the Prophet clan.
Can I bet?
Not willing to gamble.
I don’t dare to gamble either.
As the vice-dean said, if the bet fails, the entire Ancient Academy will be refined and there will be no burial place. This is a result he cannot accept.
"Let me know, if anyone is willing to leave, they can leave the academy at any time."
"Dean, what about you?"
"I want to stay."
It’s not that I don’t want to leave.
Can you walk?
